### what_to_do_first.details[1]
Sentence: Because the Health Care Act sets no legal maximum time for a cancer suspicion and national pathway monitoring is lacking, the team recommends reporting referral-to-treatment access times using THL Ohjaus 21/2016 definitions (covering 16 cancers) with handover alerts; the Filha programme's diagnostics recommendation with recommended time limits is to be carried out before the 2030 mid-term evaluation.
